# pdfmake 0.2.20

Vendored from https://github.com/bpampuch/pdfmake/tree/0.2.20/build.
MIT license included. Lazy-loaded only when a statement PDF is requested.
The library is served by this app; no report data is sent to an external PDF service.

Bengali PDFs use Hind Siliguri (regular/bold), from
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/hindsiliguri.
English runs use Noto Sans (regular/bold), from
https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans.
The SIL Open Font License is included in each font directory.
Explicit script runs preserve Bengali shaping and searchable English text.
